title: Ubungqina Obuqinileyo
intro: Ibali elinzulu liyavela, lityhila ukuzimisela okungagungqiyo koluntu xa lujamelene nogonyamelo olukhulu. Ibali labo lisebenza njengobungqina bokholo, nangona lujongene nombingelelo omkhulu. Le ngxelo isikhumbuza ngamandla okukholelwa nxamnye noxinzelelo olukhulu.
clues: Sasiliqela elalibaliswa kwi-surah emfutshane nenamandla, ilumkisa ngentshutshiso.
Sajongana nomlawuli owayefuna ukuphelisa ukukholelwa kwethu kuThixo omnye, iNkosi yeTrone, uMdumisi.
Safumana uvavanyo olubi kakhulu olubandakanya umngxuma omkhulu owembiwe emhlabeni.
Sabukela njengoko amakholwa, kuquka neentsana, ephoswa esihogweni esivuthayo ngaphakathi kuloo mngxuma.
Abathuthumbisi bethu baqalekiswa ngenxa yezenzo zabo, ngoxa thina sathenjiswa umvuzo omkhulu ngokunyamezela kwethu.
Imizamo yomlawuli yokucima ukholo lwethu yaqinisa indawo yethu njengabafeli-nkolo phambi kuka-Allah, ongungqina wezinto zonke.
arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
